channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 12
item.description:
48 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • PT boats now prioritize visible targets and no longer abandon targets above sea level, improving boat combat reliability.
  • First‑person laser sights are functional again, restoring accurate aiming.
  • Magazine drops now use the same system as the glass AK, standardizing drop rates and locations for all mags.

Vehicles & Boats

  • PT boats now prioritize visible targets and no longer abandon targets above sea level, improving boat combat reliability.
  • Fixed boat privilege regression, restoring proper player permissions when using the boat privilege cache.

Weapons & Combat

  • First‑person laser sights are functional again, restoring accurate aiming.
  • Explosives attached to solar panels now retain correct size, preventing unintended damage scaling.

Items & DLC

  • Halloween lights are now craftable with correct stack size and cost, and the alien suit now blocks the torso instead of the legs.

Base & Environment

  • Spiral staircase upkeep now counts correctly, ensuring proper base maintenance costs.
  • Arctic biome refrigeration now only triggers above a 10% arctic threshold, stopping accidental cooling in marginal arctic zones.

Input & Gamepad

  • Gamepad stick drift ignored when not the active input device, preventing unintended movement.
  • Gamepad duck‑latch logic isolated, fixing escape‑menu input clearing issues.

Loot & Economy

  • Magazine drops now use the same system as the glass AK, standardizing drop rates and locations for all mags.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 11
item.description:
30 development commits

Structures

  • Chainlink gates now open at normal speed instead of being twice as slow.

Cosmetics

  • Spraycan reskin now correctly applies the chosen material on low‑quality double doors.

Vehicles & Mounts

  • Vehicle mount points can now be sized and overlapped, allowing a large flatbed mount to replace two small mounts; you can still load two sheep but not two cows.

Livestock & Farming

  • Livestock will now eat from troughs even when grass is present, and the amount of grass reduces the food value they receive.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Terrain configs now load correctly in the demo, preventing missing or broken terrain for players.
  • Building privilege checks are now cached, cutting the check time from ~4.6 ms to ~0.5 ms in large bases, reducing building lag.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 10
item.description:
13 development commits

Resources & Farming

  • Apples now spawn exactly at the location of their loot container on trees, changing where they can be collected.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed laserbeam job processing to correctly use current materials, preventing resource loss and ensuring builds function as intended.
